ticket.title: Please refund my invoice
ticket.body: I want a refund of 200 dollars for invoice INV-204 dated 10 November. Please confirm it has been approved and tell me the date the money will arrive.

review.note: Demonstration review by build agent against example documentation. Billing handoff: invoice INV-204 dated10 November; customer requested$200. No refund approval, amount or arrival date has been confirmed. Collect the issue description and have billing review.

reasons: The proposed next action requires clarification or a human handoff
